citation.title: Optimal MSE polarisation angle and q-profile estimation using Kalman filters and the plasma simulator RAPTOR
citation.authors: M C C Messmer, F Felici, O Sauter, A A Teplukhina, J P G Loenen, M Reich, R Fischer, D Rittich, R J E Jaspers, the ASDEX Upgrade Team and the EUROfusion MST1 team

topic: EKF fusing RAPTOR current-diffusion/Te model with AUG MSE polarisation angles for q-profile estimation
own_question: Can MSE-constrained RAPTOR, coupled to CHEASE, give accurate q-profile estimates?
actual_method_and_evidence: Synthetic test with a perturbed model and 0.5 deg noise. One AUG shot (#33134) was compared with an IDE reference, giving a figure-of-merit reduction from 0.19 to 0.05. The analysis was offline with CHEASE, which is not real-time. Measurement covariance was derived from pi-sigma channel differences. A signal-loss test showed reversion toward the unconstrained model. The paper does not address CES, ion temperature, BES/ECEI, or data-driven nowcasting.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Model-based recursive estimators such as an EKF have been used to merge physics-model predictions with noisy tokamak diagnostics in offline analyses that are described as real-time capable.
claim_checks.qualification: The target is the q-profile from MSE. It was shown offline on one AUG shot, and real-time use was stated as future work.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Inputs were MSE angles on a 1-5 ms simulation step. The target was the q-profile, using a reference reconstruction (IDE) rather than truth. Measurement arrival latency was not studied.
validation_if_relevant: Synthetic nominal case plus a single discharge, with no held-out set.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite as CES, Ti, impurity, or BES/ECEI evidence.
Do not claim a real-time deployment was demonstrated.
Do not treat IDE as physical truth.
Do not generalize from one shot.
Do not claim it supports our nowcasting performance.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Optional background on model-based state observers only. It is not a comparator for our CES nowcasting.
